_comment: The fixed demo scenario of decision C58. Both servers (the hooks example in Rust and demo/ts-server.mjs) run it over stdio. Each session starts without a session_id, so the SDK issues a new one. The custom event comes from the echo tool, as in hooks.rs: it publishes one custom event per echo call, so the three echo calls give three custom events on the dashboard, not one. The second echo of session one carries secret-token, which redact_sensitive_information replaces with [REDACTED]. The add call carries intent text in the context argument.

steps.context: Adding two numbers to check the total of a demo order
Sending text that holds a secret
Looking up a record that does not exist
